author: Paul Thrasher
text: Firecracker backend now working on rookery (Linux KVM). Tested: ~800ms boot+exec+shutdown cycle, guest agent vsock communication, kernel 6.1.70-agentkernel + Alpine 3.20 rootfs. Ready to proceed with Phase 2: Docker image to ext4 rootfs conversion.

author: Paul Thrasher
text: Basic PTY and attach with env vars done. Remaining: vsock protocol (Firecracker-specific), network/file proxies, session recording, WebSocket API, K8s Helm. Session recording (asciicast) is the quick win.

author: Paul Thrasher
text:
Phase 3 complete! Docker image to ext4 rootfs conversion working. Features:
- convert_image_to_rootfs() in src/rootfs.rs
- docker save + privileged container for layer extraction
- Guest agent injection and init script creation
- Automatic caching of both Docker images and rootfs
- ~838ms execution cycle for custom Dockerfile + Firecracker
- Tested with Python 3.12 in Alpine-based Dockerfile

Remaining for full epic completion: Phase 4 (registry push/pull, security scanning) is optional/future work.
